## Professional Summary
Usama Tariq is a Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience building scalable web platforms across SaaS, telecom, and consumer technology. He specializes in full-stack JavaScript and TypeScript systems using React, Node.js, and AWS. His work focuses on execution quality, system performance, cloud automation, and business-impact-driven engineering.

## Core Expertise
- Full-stack web development (React, Node.js, TypeScript)
- Cloud & serverless architecture (AWS Lambda, Lambda@Edge, CloudFront)
- CI/CD and infrastructure automation
- Performance optimization and system reliability
- AI feature integration (OpenAI APIs)

## Notable Work

- Serverless edge architecture improving latency and global scalability
- Front-end performance optimization reducing load times by ~30%
